summary: Imported all previously published allocations without renumbering or inferring missing cryptographic bindings.
Adopted version 2 governance and data-model policies.
Ratified delegation DLG-2026-0001 as a structured administrative instrument.
Adopted managedTrust policy definitions under the recorded single-operator exception.
Allocated the managedTrust family and ten private certificate-policy identifiers.
Allocated five G6 trust anchors and immutable group version 0 without modifying legacy assignments.
Verified root SPKI/certificate digests and SKI using independent cryptographic implementations and recorded exact artifacts before activation.

Appended five verified cross-certificates with unchanged SPKI and SKI, and published six modern and six old-root-compatible issuing-CA chains. No OID, trust-anchor identity or effective policy is reassigned.

Verified ten reissued certificates with identical registered root keys/SKI, no AKI on five self-signed roots, and exact requested EKUs on cross-certificates. Refreshed six modern and six legacy paths. OpenSSL does not treat the Identity anyExtendedKeyUsage CA EKU as a clientAuth wildcard; the requested EKU is retained and this limitation is recorded. Prior certificates remain historical valid certificates; no revocation was requested in this revision.
